description: Synthetic questions authored by a separate coding agent after reading the implemented app and sample documents. These are not human-expert labels, customer traffic, or evidence of LLM answer accuracy. The held_out subset was authored after implementation and its labels are not tuned to observed results. The held_out failures were subsequently inspected during implementation fixes; final results are diagnostic, not a blind generalization estimate.
status_definition: evidence_found requests useful source excerpts, not a correct generated answer. needs_review requests abstention when the requested fact is absent. Expected documents and text fragments check retrieval usefulness only.

expected_text: Verify a successful request with the new key before revoking the old key.

cases.question: How can I avoid handling the same callback twice?
What is the API rate limit?

update.text: The API rate limit is 250 requests per minute per workspace. A 429 response includes a Retry-After header in seconds. Wait for that interval before retrying.
